name: test_admin_cleanup_executes_the_full_dependency_order
description:
Objective: Admin cleanup executes the full dependency order.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/admin/test_admin_cleanup.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `_registered_dependency_cleanup.cleanup` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `events == ['team:goto', 'team:remove-member:QA Team Safe:QA User Safe:qa.user.safe@kesef.com', 'team:delete:QA Team Safe', 'user:goto', 'user:delete:QA User Safe:qa.user.safe@kesef.com', 'permission:goto', 'permission:activate:QA Permission Safe', 'role:goto', 'role:deactivate:QA Role Safe', 'role:search:QA Role Safe', 'role:users:QA Role Safe:0', 'role:delete:QA Role Safe', 'permission:goto', 'permission:deactivate:QA Permission Safe', 'permission:delete:QA Permission Safe']`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Admin cleanup executes the full dependency order.
2. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `events == ['team:goto', 'team:remove-member:QA Team Safe:QA User Safe:qa.user.safe@kesef.com', 'team:delete:QA Team Safe', 'user:goto', 'user:delete:QA User Safe:qa.user.safe@kesef.com', 'permission:goto', 'permission:activate:QA Permission Safe', 'role:goto', 'role:deactivate:QA Role Safe', 'role:search:QA Role Safe', 'role:users:QA Role Safe:0', 'role:delete:QA Role Safe', 'permission:goto', 'permission:deactivate:QA Permission Safe', 'permission:delete:QA Permission Safe']`.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
